input.rationale: Section 5 provides only for revenue sharing as set out in each Exhibit and tax responsibility; there is no most-favoured-nation, "no less favourable terms" or price-matching obligation anywhere in the Agreement, and nothing requires Customer to extend to Kubient terms given to third parties.
input.quote: The Parties agree to share any revenue generated as a result of this Agreement, or Customer's use of the Services or the Auction Platform, as set forth and detailed in each applicable Exhibit.
The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: There is no non-solicitation, no-hire or non-inducement covenant binding Customer; searches of the confidentiality and general provisions show no "solicit", "employ" or "hire" restriction. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: Customer has no convenience right during the Initial Term or during any auto-renewed term other than a 90-day for-any-reason notice, and Kubient enjoys the same walk-away right after the Initial Term. Our position is a Customer convenience exit on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, with any Vendor convenience right limited to the end of a term on 90 days' notice.

input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews in 12-month increments with no dedicated non-renewal mechanic, so the only exit is a 90-day for-any-reason notice — longer than our 30-day (fallback 60-day) window. We added an express 30-day non-renewal notice right; renewal length (12 months) is acceptable and there is no price-uplift language given the revenue-share model.
